intro_html: All the saucy, cheesy comfort of enchiladas with zero rolling and zero oven fuss. Each bowl brings 51 grams of protein for about $4.30 a serving (at everyday cost). Fourteen servings out of one skillet keeps the whole week covered.
cost_closing_html: About $4.30 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
portion_html: Each of the 14 bowls gives you 51 grams of protein and about 671 calories.
upsell_html: Cheesy, saucy, and cheap, this one disappears fast, so make the full batch. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: Buy the 7 lb ground turkey pack and let the cheap beans and rice do the stretching.
Canned enchilada sauce in the store brand saves money over the name brands and tastes just as good in the pan.
One bag of shredded cheddar is enough for the whole batch, so no need to double up.
make_it: Brown the ground turkey in a large skillet, then drain any excess liquid.
Stir in the enchilada sauce and the chopped chipotle in adobo for a smoky kick.
Add the black beans and corn and let it all simmer together.
Fold in the cooked rice and stir until everything is warm and coated.
Top with shredded cheddar, cover for a minute to melt it, then dish into bowls.
